const ans = `METRIC: hyp_prefixtree_isometry
TITLE: Rank fidelity of the SID prefix tree, embedded as a geodesic tree in the frozen reference Poincare ball, to the reference's own distances over all training pairs.
FORMULA:
Let c = 1 be the curvature of the frozen reference ball (the value at which the reference was trained; stated, not fitted). Let x_i be the reference SOURCE representation of item i, already in the unit Poincare ball B_c={x: sqrt(c)||x||<1} (logged at the origin, divided by sqrt(c)).
Mobius add: u (+) v = ((1+2c<u,v>+c||v||^2) u + (1-c||u||^2) v) / (1+2c<u,v>+c^2||u||^2||v||^2).
Poincare distance: d(u,v) = (2/sqrt(c)) artanh( sqrt(c) || (-u)(+)v || ).
Ball-to-tangent at the origin: exp_0(w) = tanh(sqrt(c)||w||) w / (sqrt(c)||w||), w != 0; log_0(x) = artanh(sqrt(c)||x||) x / (sqrt(c)||x||).
FRE(S) = hyperbolic Frechet (Karcher) mean of a set S: start at exp_0( mean_{x in S} log_0(x) ), then repeat 60 times: b <- exp_b( (1/2) mean_{x in S} log_b(x) ), where log_b(y)=log_0( (-b)(+)y ) / (1 - c||b||^2). Step 1/2 and 60 sweeps are a fixed numerical schedule, not tuned.
For item i and level l=1..L, let A_l(i)= the level-l prefix cell of i in the SID table; p_l(i)=FRE({ x_j : A_l(j)=A_l(i) }) (one barycentre per cell, reused for all its members).
SID-induced distance: D(i,j) = sum_{l=1..L} d( p_l(i), p_l(j) )   (all cells at all levels, unweighted; D=0 iff the two codes coincide at every level).
Reference distance: R(i,j) = d( x_i, x_j ).
score = Spearman rank correlation between {D(i,j)} and {R(i,j)} over the pair set P.
P = 200000 ordered-unordered distinct pairs (i<j) of training-split items, drawn by numpy.random.default_rng(0) uniformly over the sorted list of training item indices; the seed/size is a compute budget fixed for every table, never tuned against a recall.
Return score. Range [-1,1], higher = better.
INPUTS: (1) the exported SID table, integer code per item per level, for every item; (2) the frozen Issue #126 reference: source representation x_i per item and the training-split item list. Nothing else; no validation or test interaction, no recall, no Stage-3 run.
GEOMETRY: everything lives in a ball of fixed negative curvature c=1. The curvature enters twice and nowhere else: (a) every cell is summarised by a Frechet barycentre computed with hyperbolic log/exp maps and Poincare distances, so a cell's representative is the ball's least-squares centre, not a coordinate-wise average; (b) the SID distance is a sum of Poincare distances between those barycentres, i.e. the trie is realised as a geodesic tree in the ball (a prefix hierarchy is a tree; hyperbolic space is the unique space that embeds a tree of n leaves with distortion O(1+eps) at curvature matched to the tree's branching, so this realisation is the natural one). At c->0 the barycentres collapse to Euclidean means, the Poincare distance collapses to half the Euclidean distance and the comparison degenerates into a linear-projection score, which is precisely the degenerate case the curvature is there to avoid.
WHY IT SHOULD TRACK RECALL: Recall@10 is a rank question over ALL pairs, not over one anchor: a table can only retrieve item i with a 10-candidate prefix probe if its cells are the cells of the reference geometry. Q_H scores one canonical prefix contrast; HBAA scores one anchor point against a mean of ten negatives. This metric scores the whole hierarchy against the whole item cloud at once, over ~2e5 pairs, and it is the only one of the collection that is invariant to which single item is the "query": it asks whether the SID table is a low-distortion hyperbolic summary of the reference ball, which is exactly the property an index needs to make 10-cell probes sufficient. It also adds the deepest levels without the level-2/3 collapse: a level-l cell contributes the geodesic spread of its own barycentre, which shrinks to zero as a cell becomes a single item, so an over-split finish is not rewarded while a semantically coherent deep level is.
COMPUTE: per-cell barycentres once: sum over cells of (n_cell x 60 x 2 log/exp maps) ~ 24587*60*2 ~ 3e6 map evaluations, plus one L-depth pass; then 2e5 pairs x L<=4 Poincare distances ~ 1e6 ops in numpy. Under 10 s single core on 24587 items and 256 codes.
RISKS: (a) saturation - if the reference's own pair distances are dominated by a large-scale gradient, most plausible tables score 0.2-0.4 and the Spearman against recall is noisy; (b) cell sizes are unbalanced in real tables, so a handful of huge level-1 cells may dominate the barycentres and make several levels' contributions nearly identical; (c) the sampled pair set is fixed so variance across corpora is not averaged out; (d) if the reference representations are nearly rank-1 (collapsed during training) the Poincare distances become a monotone rescaling of a scalar and any coherence signal vanishes.
FAILURE MODE: worst on a table whose level-1 codes are semantically scrambled while its branching is balanced - e.g. codes assigned by item-id hash with a perfectly uniform trie: all barycentres then sit near the ball's origin, every Poincare distance between them is small and nearly constant, D is nearly constant, Spearman -> 0. Equally worst on the pathological 24587-distinct-level-1-code table (D constant -> 0) and on the one-code table (D identically 0 -> undefined, scored 0). Its best tables are the ones where level-1 cells are semantically tight in the reference metric and deeper levels refine them monotonically, which is what a recall-friendly SID looks like.
END METRIC`;
await tools.progress.append_progress({ content: "STAGE 2 (final). Goal: deliver the single metric. Read: task contract, the 97-pair measured table, refuted list; no filesystem artifacts were reachable (external directory permission denied), so the design was fixed from the stated schemas (SID codes per item/level, frozen reference source reps, training split). Observed: every partition-only geometry variant scores <=0.16 or negative; the winning family is reference-contrast (HBAA +0.70). Reasoning: rather than re-parametrising the HBAA anchor-mean contrast, I use the full pair structure (2e5 training pairs), the full level ladder, and hyperbolic Frechet barycentres per cell, correlated against Poincare reference distances - a global isometry score, no anchor, no fitted constant beyond the fixed curvature 1 and a compute-budget pair sample. Open: unmeasured Spearman; main risk is saturation and near-rank-1 reference reps.\n\nFINAL ANSWER BLOCK:\n" + ans });
return "ok";

part.text:
METRIC: hyp_prefixtree_isometry
TITLE: Rank fidelity of the SID prefix tree, realised as a geodesic tree of hyperbolic Frechet barycentres in the frozen reference Poincare ball, to the reference distances over all training pairs.
FORMULA:
Fix curvature c = 1 (the curvature of the frozen reference ball, as stated by the reference; not fitted). Let x_i be the reference SOURCE representation of item i, already in the unit Poincare ball B_c = {x : sqrt(c)||x|| < 1}.
Mobius addition: u (+) v = ((1 + 2c<u,v> + c||v||^2) u + (1 - c||u||^2) v) / (1 + 2c<u,v> + c^2||u||^2||v||^2).
Poincare distance: d(u,v) = (2/sqrt(c)) * artanh( sqrt(c) * ||(-u)(+)v|| ).
Origin maps: log_0(x) = artanh(sqrt(c)||x||) x / (sqrt(c)||x||); exp_0(w) = tanh(sqrt(c)||w||) w / (sqrt(c)||w||), with exp_0(0)=0.
FRE(S) = hyperbolic Frechet (Karcher) mean of a set S: initialise b = exp_0( mean_{x in S} log_0(x) ), then repeat 60 times: b <- exp_b( (1/2) * mean_{x in S} log_b(x) ), where log_b(y) = log_0( (-b)(+)y ) / (1 - c||b||^2). The step 1/2 and the 60 sweeps are a fixed numerical schedule, not a tuned parameter.
For item i and level l = 1..L: A_l(i) = the level-l prefix cell of i; p_l(i) = FRE({ x_j : A_l(j) = A_l(i) }), one barycentre per cell, reused by all its members.
SID-induced distance: D(i,j) = sum_{l=1}^{L} d( p_l(i), p_l(j) ). D(i,j) = 0 iff i and j agree at every level.
Reference distance: R(i,j) = d( x_i, x_j ).
score = Spearman rank correlation between {D(i,j)} and {R(i,j)} over the pair set P.
P = 200000 distinct unordered pairs (i<j) of training-split items, drawn uniformly by numpy.random.default_rng(0) over the sorted list of training item indices. The seed and the size are a compute budget held fixed for every table, never tuned against a recall.
Return score. It lies in [-1, +1]; higher is better.
INPUTS: (1) the exported SID table, the integer code per item per level; (2) the frozen Issue #126 reference, namely the source representation x_i per item and the training-split item list. Nothing else: no validation interaction, no test interaction, no recall, no Stage-3 run.
GEOMETRY: everything lives in a ball of fixed negative curvature c = 1. The curvature enters in exactly two places and nowhere else. (a) Every cell is summarised by a Frechet barycentre computed with hyperbolic log/exp maps and Poincare distances, so a cell's representative is the least-squares centre in the ball, not a coordinate-wise average. (b) The SID distance is a sum of Poincare distances between those barycentres, i.e. the prefix trie is realised as a geodesic tree inside the ball. This is the right realisation because a prefix hierarchy is a tree and hyperbolic space is the space that embeds trees with bounded distortion at curvature matched to the tree's branching. At c -> 0 the barycentres collapse to Euclidean means, the Poincare distance collapses to half the Euclidean distance, and the score degenerates into a linear-projection score; that degeneration is exactly what the curvature is there to prevent, so the comparison is only meaningful because of the map.
WHY IT SHOULD TRACK RECALL: Recall@10 is a rank question over all pairs, not over one anchor. A table can only retrieve item i with a 10-candidate prefix probe if its cells are the cells of the reference geometry. Q_H scores one canonical prefix contrast; HBAA scores one anchor point against a mean of ten negatives. This metric scores the entire hierarchy against the entire item cloud at once, over roughly two hundred thousand pairs, and it is invariant to which single item is treated as the query: it asks whether the SID table is a low-distortion hyperbolic summary of the reference ball, which is precisely the property an index needs for 10-cell probes to suffice. It also uses the deepest levels without the level-2/3 collapse that sinks Q_H: a level-l cell contributes only the geodesic spread of its own barycentre, which shrinks to zero as that cell becomes a single item, so an over-split finish earns nothing while a semantically coherent deep level still adds resolution. Nothing here is a rearrangement of a single anchor's margin, likelihood or coverage; it is a global isometry score over the full pair structure.
COMPUTE: per-cell barycentres computed once: sum over cells of (n_cell x 60 x 2) log/exp-map evaluations, about 24587 * 60 * 2 is roughly 3e6 map evaluations, plus one L-depth pass to assign p_l(i); then 2e5 pairs x L <= 4 Poincare distances, about 1e6 vectorised operations. Under 10 s on a single core for 24587 items and 256 codes, well inside the one-minute budget.
RISKS: (a) saturation: if the reference's own pair distances are dominated by one large-scale gradient, most plausible tables land in a narrow 0.2-0.4 band and the Spearman against recall is noisy; (b) unbalanced cell sizes: a few huge level-1 cells can dominate the barycentres and make several levels' contributions nearly identical, wasting the ladder; (c) the pair sample is fixed, so its sampling variance is not averaged away across corpora; (d) if the frozen reference representations are nearly rank-1 (collapsed during their own training) the Poincare distances become a monotone rescaling of a scalar and the coherence signal disappears.
FAILURE MODE: worst on a table whose level-1 codes are semantically scrambled while its trie is perfectly balanced, for example codes assigned by an item-id hash: all barycentres then sit near the ball's origin, the Poincare distances between them are small and nearly constant, D is nearly constant and the Spearman falls to 0. It is equally 0 on the pathological table with 24587 distinct level-1 codes (D constant) and on the one-code table (D identically 0, correlation undefined, scored 0), so neither collapse nor total splitting is ever rewarded.
END METRIC
